root_cause.text: The xchk_xfile_*_descr macros used kasprintf to dynamically format xfile description strings without checking for memory allocation failure, allowing a NULL pointer dereference when kasprintf returns NULL due to memory pressure or large formatted strings.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "The xchk_xfile_*_descr macros call kasprintf, which can fail to allocate memory ... Jiaming Zhang found a few places where that can happen with syzbot." The patch removes all uses of these macros and replaces them with static strings, explicitly "eliminating this path to failure."
